connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.vulk.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package vulk-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the devjoaocastro account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
